title: Origins: Difficulties
description: Adds new difficulties to Minecraft using the Origins Mod!
body:
Adds 3 new difficulties to Minecraft:

**Expert** - makes the game harder without straying too far from the vanilla experience!

**Masochist** - The main difficulty of the datapack, completely reshaping the game by adding new weapons and mechanics whilst making it massively more difficult.

**Hydrophilic** - Turns any player into a fish.
